roomHeroHighlights.text: Curtained privacy pods in the mixed dorm
Four-bed dorms with male and female options
A/C and heat, secure lockers, power sockets, and WiFi
All rooms include breakfast every morning (excl. off-season)

offerings.name: Privacy Pod Dorm
offerings.label: Best for solo travelers who want privacy without losing the hostel vibe
offerings.description: The signature room at Scodrinon pairs the energy of a social hostel with the comfort of a private sleep setup.
offerings.alt: 18-bed privacy pod dorm with curtained beds and personal space at Scodrinon Hostel, Shkoder
bullets: Curtained pod layout for real personal space
Reading light and 2 power sockets at every bed
Easy to meet people without feeling exposed all night

images.alt: Privacy Pod Dorm Room at Scodrinon Hostel

offerings.name: 4-Bed Dorms
offerings.label: Best for lighter sleepers, small groups, and guests wanting a calmer setup
offerings.description: The four-bed rooms keep the same clean, modern essentials while giving you a quieter rhythm after a long day out in Shkoder or the Alps.
offerings.alt: Four-bed dorm room at Scodrinon Hostel, Shkoder
bullets: Good fit for early hikes and slower mornings
A solid balance between privacy and price

images.alt: Four Bed Dorm Room at Scodrinon Hostel
